# Roadmap

An agent-first diagram language: state the facts once, choose a lens.

horsegirl is an agent-first diagram language. This file is generated from the
items in `cairn/items` by `cairn render`. Do not edit it by hand.

Each milestone is a release that a stranger can install and use. Releases are
named for gaits: Walk, Trot, Canter, Gallop.
